capabilities: Display a calendar in the side pane with month and year navigation
List notes created on a selected date or week by creation time
Create Daily Notes on double-click using the Daily Notes core plugin for templating
Configure week numbers, week start day, note indicators, sorting, and excerpts
extras: The marketplace listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Groups notes by file creation time, not filename or frontmatter date.
problem: Obsidian has no calendar view for finding notes by their creation date or week.
summary: Sidebar calendar plugin that lists notes by the date or week they were created, with optional daily note creation.
